summary: Consolidated M1 read-path and Web rendering candidate. Earlier per-stage manifests retained in Git history; one exact changed-path manifest for PR review.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore/EventStore, Web history API and React UI; no new execution authority or service.
components.disposition: Bound complete JSON cache by source bytes and LRU; source-bound display metadata and offset-only index with existing identity/lease checks and exact fallback; revision hints and guarded pagination; 50-row compact pages with explicit SHA256-bound original hydration; selective exact retraction reads and bounded explicit legacy rebuild. Stable persisted row identity; native content-visibility for long history, preserve all DOM and measured tail; one shared visible-tab Board polling lifecycle, auth/late-response guards. Canonical session/event/Goal/Run data and model context semantics unchanged.

components.verification_level: Stage-local targeted tests, synthetic storage/HTTP benchmarks and isolated Chrome qualification. Independent final SHA review, original R9, remote CI, production Mac/Deepin and physical phone acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto on lost/mixed/retracted content, cross-workspace identity, stale source acceptance, duplicate side effects, or UI scroll/navigation regressions. Source-byte cache weights are not RSS caps; cold scan and legacy/oversized fallback remain proportional to source. Native rendering skips offscreen content but retains DOM; no measured production click P95 claim. M2 write amplification and M3 model quality/recovery remain separately evidenced, not solved by M1.
components.rollback_route: Revert M1 code; canonical sources unchanged. Derived sidecars ignored by old readers; old API remains compatible. No production backfill or deployment in this candidate.
